definitions.explanation: Describes something happening without deliberate action, force, or artificial intervention. The process or result occurs on its own.

definitions.gloss: in a natural manner; without affectation
definitions.explanation: Describes behaving, speaking, or appearing in a way that is relaxed and unforced, without seeming artificial or stiff.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自然|しぜん}に⟦{治|なお}る→治る：19598_naoru⟧。
⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{自然|しぜん}に⟦{流|なが}れて→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧きた。
⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{自然|しぜん}に⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧になった。
examples.english: My Japanese got better naturally while I was living there.

examples.japanese: {自然|しぜん}に⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧。
⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{自然|しぜん}に⟦{笑|わら}える→笑う：00685_warau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うらやましい。
examples.english: I envy people who can smile naturally even in front of a camera.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初対面|しょたいめん}→初対面：07306_shotaimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧とも{自然|しぜん}に⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: He can converse naturally even with people he's meeting for the first time.

notes:
Adverbial form of ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧ (nature; natural) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. One of the most commonly used adverbs in Japanese. The two senses overlap but have distinct nuances:
- Sense 1: focuses on processes happening without human intervention
- Sense 2: focuses on behavior that appears unforced and comfortable

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自然|しぜん}に⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つく: to acquire naturally (skills, habits)
- {自然|しぜん}に⟦{治|なお}る→治る：19598_naoru⟧: to heal naturally
- {自然|しぜん}に⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧: to disappear on its own
- {自然|しぜん}に⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧: to act naturally

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: naturally; spontaneously — very similar but slightly more literary; emphasizes inevitability
- ⟦ひとりでに→ひとりでに：30288_hitorideni⟧: by itself; on its own — emphasizes that no person caused the action
- ⟦{自発的|じはつてき}→自発的：06132_jihatsuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: voluntarily; of one's own accord — implies conscious choice, unlike {自然|しぜん}に which implies no deliberation
